name: uses first discovery as the priority tie breaker and permits more per host when budget allows
input: two equal-priority URLs from one case-variant host and one other host
test:
candidates = [
    {'url': 'https://A.test/first', 'priority': 2},
    {'url': 'https://b.test/only', 'priority': 2},
    {'url': 'https://a.test/second', 'priority': 2},
]
assert plan_crawl_frontier(candidates, per_host_limit=2, global_limit=5) == ['https://A.test/first', 'https://b.test/only', 'https://a.test/second']
assert plan_crawl_frontier(candidates, per_host_limit=2, global_limit=0) == []
